messages:
olive: Kicking off v2 rollout in us-central at 09:00 UTC. Deploy-bot shows routing flags set. Heads-up: we have a hook that treats missing api-version header as v1, but v2 expects it. Watching for client errors.

deploy-bot: [deploy] v2 -> 50% traffic us-central at 09:02 UTC. Telemetry: 1.4% increase in 422 payload errors, customer impact concentrated on apps using old proxy.

max: quick glance at logs -> many 422s include 'unknown-field: response_format' coming from our new validation in v2. Older proxies are stripping headers and sending payload shape we reject.

tara: can we put a short-term gateway compatibility mode that accepts the legacy shape? Prefer that to tenant-wide pin. It's less disruptive.

jordan: compatibility toggle exists but it's per-cluster; enabling globally would increase risk of regressing v2 guarantees. Suggest targeted tenant pin for top 10 affected customers while we add a permissive parsing fallback.

ops-bot: suggested runbook: 1) open emergency channel, 2) apply tenant pins for high-impact customers, 3) deploy permissive-parse to canary cluster, 4) monitor 15m, 5) progressively widen.

olive: deploy-bot, can you list top 10 affected tenant ids so we can decide pins? Also include traffic percent and revenue impact estimate.

deploy-bot: Top-affected: tenant-113 (2.1% traffic, high), tenant-47 (1.5%, medium), tenant-9 (1.1%, low), tenant-201, tenant-78, tenant-5, tenant-332, tenant-88, tenant-414, tenant-2. Combined ~10% of canary traffic. Revenue-critical = tenant-113.

max: plan: flip tenant-113 to v1 pin for now, roll permissive parser to canary (json-compat flag), if clean after 15m remove pin and widen. If not clean, escalate rollback.

tara: any docs impact? We need to add a short "compatibility" note in the v2 release notes and update the SDK migration guide with the known legacy payload pattern. I'll draft.

emma: I can notify our integrations Slack and send an email to tenant-113 ops contact. Will include workaround steps (proxy upgrade) and ETA for parser fix.

deploy-bot: action: apply tenant pin tenant-113 -> v1 at 09:10 UTC (operator @jordan). Canary flag json-compat scheduled for 09:12 UTC.

jordan: applied pin for tenant-113. Confirmed redirect to v1 in routing logs.

max: pushing permissive parser to canary now with config:
```yaml
feature_flags:
  - name: json-compat
    enabled: true
    scope: canary
```

ops-bot: monitoring window started. Watchlist: 4xx/5xx rates, latency p50/p95, and error tag "unknown-field: response_format".

olive: after 10m looks like 422s for the wider set dropped 85%. Tenant-113 stable on v1. Good candidate for removing pin once we widen parser.

emma: outreach sent to tenant-113 contact. They acknowledged and will prioritize proxy upgrade; appreciate the pin.

tara: drafting release note change: "v2 introduces stricter payload validation. Temporary compatibility mode available; older proxies may be pinned to v1. See migration guide."

olive: decision: keep tenant-113 pinned for now until we validate parser widened to prod. We'll keep permissive parser on canary for another 15m then widen to one region. If any regressions, we'll revert and schedule a full rollback.

deploy-bot: scheduled widen: permissive parser -> region us-west at 09:40 UTC. If error rate > 0.5% above baseline for 10m, auto-revert to previous config and notify channel.

max: test plan post-widen: run integration suite against a set of legacy payloads and ensure no silent data corruption. Add unit to parser tests.

emma: docs PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/431 title: "v2 compatibility note and migration steps".

ops-bot: reminder: update rollback playbook with tenant-pin decision tree and communication templates. Also add a section for revenue-prioritized pin ordering.

olive: thanks. Action items captured: jordan=maintain pin list, max=parser fix + tests, tara=docs update, emma=integrator comms, ops-bot=playbook update. We'll reconvene in retro to formalize preflight checks for payload contract. Closing thread when permissive parser is in prod and tenant pins are removed.

jordan: widening parser to us-west now. No spike in 5xx. 422s down to baseline. Removing tenant-113 pin at 09:52 UTC.

deploy-bot: tenant-113 removed from pinlist at 09:52 UTC. Traffic now on v2.

olive: excellent. Keeping a follow-up ticket for a postmortem and adding an automated preflight that verifies header+payload patterns for SDKs.

ops-bot: postmortem ticket created: infra#887, retro scheduled.

olive: closing thread. Thanks everyone."
